name: Hillwalker Ruaridh

intro.text: I'm walking the Skye Trail, 128 kilometres from Rubha Hunish to Broadford. I've had three days of rain, two of wind and one of both. Perfect.

win: Och. I need a sit down and a dram of tea.
after: Rubha Hunish is the northernmost tip of Skye, with a lookout bothy that the walkers use. It has a lovely view and a draught.
